data.doc: Confirm plugin: .show(plugin, dispatch!, next-task) and .show-with-text(plugin, dispatch!, text, next-task). dispatch! receives one Enum operation, including (:: :states cursor data), and returns Unit; next-task receives no arguments and returns Unit. |Alert dialog hook. Shows a simple message box. Returns a plugin object with .show method to display the alert.

Build a Confirm plugin from Respo states and options. Call (.show plugin dispatch! (fn () ...)) with the ordinary single-Enum dispatcher; the success task is zero-argument. Rendering does not invoke the success task. Closing clears it. The old two-argument cursor/data dispatcher is not supported.
|Drawer hook. Shows a panel sliding from the side. Use :render function in options to customize content. Supports :style for width and other styles.
|Modal dialog hook. Shows a modal with custom content. Use :render function in options to customize content. Returns a plugin object.
|Modal menu hook. Shows a modal dialog with a list of options. Define options via :items and handle selection via :on-result in options.
|Prompt dialog hook. Shows a dialog with text input. Returns a plugin object, call .show with a callback function to receive user input text.
